title: Development of a new culture medium for bioflocculant production using chicken viscera
author: Mohammed, Wan Dagang

steps.title: Collect and process chicken viscera
steps.instruction: Collect fresh chicken viscera, remove non‑viscera parts, wash thoroughly, and homogenize or mince as needed for subsequent processing.

steps.title: Hydrolyze processed chicken viscera
steps.instruction: Hydrolyze the processed chicken viscera under the conditions specified by the study (specific hydrolysis parameters are not detailed in the text).

steps.title: Optimize culture conditions
steps.instruction: Perform optimization of the culture parameters (e.g., temperature, pH, incubation time) required for bioflocculant production using the new medium.

steps.title: Purify bioflocculant from supernatant
steps.instruction: Purify the bioflocculant by ethanol precipitation, centrifugation, water washing, and drying.

substeps.instruction: Mix the rich culture supernatant with cold 95 % ethanol at a volume ratio of 1:2 (supernatant : ethanol) and incubate at 4 °C for 8 h.
Centrifuge the mixture at 10,000 rpm for 30 min at 4 °C.
Resuspend the resulting pellet in deionized water at a volume ratio of 1:2 (v/v).
Repeat the ethanol precipitation, incubation, centrifugation, and water‑wash steps two additional times.
Lyophilize the final purified bioflocculant and then vacuum‑dry it.

steps.title: Assess flocculation efficiency
steps.instruction: Determine the flocculation activity of the purified bioflocculant using a kaolin clay assay.

substeps.instruction: In a 500 mL beaker, combine 2 mL crude bioflocculant, 3 mL of 1 % CaCl₂ solution, and 100 mL kaolin clay suspension (4 g L⁻¹).
Adjust the pH of the mixture to 7.0 ± 0.1.
Mount the beaker on a flocculator (JLT 6, Velp Scientifica, Italy) and stir at 200 rpm for 1 min, then at 80 rpm for 5 min, and finally let stand still for 5 min.
Measure the absorbance of the upper layer at 550 nm with a T60 spectrophotometer for both the sample and a control (replace the bioflocculant with 2 mL sterile medium).
Calculate flocculation efficiency using: Flocculation efficiency = [(A – B)/A] × 100 %, where A is the absorbance of the control and B is the absorbance of the sample.

description: Briefly, the development of the new culture media from chicken viscera for bioflocculant production as substitute of commercial media involved the following steps:(1)Collection and processing of the chicken viscera.(2)Hydrolysis of the processed chicken viscera.(3)Optimization of the culture conditions(4)Purification of the bioflocculant and estimation of the bioflocculation activity of the bioflocculant produced from the new culture media
